feed.title: World News - Breaking international news and headlines | Sky News

articles.title: French football star Mbappe dropped by Chinese brands after 'dictator' remark
articles.summary: At least three Chinese companies are cutting ties with Kylian Mbappe after he appeared to refer to Mao Zedong, the founder of the People's Republic of China, as a dictator.

articles.title: Nurse treating Ebola patients killed by machete-wielding mob
articles.summary: A nurse responding to the Ebola outbreak has been killed by a group of young people armed with machetes, officials have said.

articles.title: Israel 'genocide' has continued in Gaza after ceasefire, UN report claims
articles.summary: Israel has continued to commit genocide in Gaza despite last October's ceasefire, a UN commission claims.

articles.title: Vatican issues Pope health update ahead of South America trip
articles.summary: The Pope is recovering well from cancer surgery and his trip to South America will go ahead as planned next month, the Vatican has said.

articles.title: Macron promises 'concrete measures' over protest demands - amid fears of Halloween unrest
articles.summary: Emmanuel Macron says his government will unveil "concrete measures" in response to the demands of student protesters for more resources in France.

articles.title: UK sanctions senior Sudanese commanders 'implicated in rape campaign'
articles.summary: Senior Sudanese commanders allegedly implicated in a campaign of rape during the country's conflict have been sanctioned by the UK government.

articles.title: North Korean howitzer guns spotted close to border with South Korea
articles.summary: North Korean howitzer guns have been seen close to the border with South Korea - at a time when tensions between the two nations are high.

articles.title: Mariupol veteran who flew in classified mission on what every Ukrainian should know
articles.summary: "Everyone in Ukraine should know how to apply a tourniquet and how to stop someone's bleeding," Anatolii says.
